output.answer_markdown: The passages do not say whether American Express retained Card Members during 2022. They give no attrition or retention figures and no year-end 2021 cards-in-force count to compare against. They report 76.7 million proprietary cards-in-force worldwide at December 31, 2022 [2] and $1,338 billion of worldwide billed business for 2022 [2]. The only earlier count is 68.9 million at December 31, 2020 [4], which skips 2021 and covers cards, not Card Members.

found: At December 31, 2022, American Express had 76.7 million proprietary cards-in-force worldwide.
Worldwide billed business for 2022 was $1,338 billion.
At December 31, 2020, there were 68.9 million proprietary cards-in-force.
missing: Cards-in-force or Card Member count at December 31, 2021
Card Member attrition or retention rates for 2022
refusal.reason: The passages contain no Card Member retention or attrition data for 2022 and no year-end 2021 cards-in-force figure to compare with the 2022 figure.
